title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Oil WTI $94.60 / Brent $99.22 (est. +7% 24h): Houthis struck Saudi Aramco in Jizan, Abha, Najran — 400k bpd refinery halted, 73 wounded. Major new escalation.
Crypto slides on Iran/rate fears: BTC $78,238 (-1.6% 24h), ETH $2,474 (-1.0% 24h) — below alert thresholds.
ECB meets tomorrow (Sep 9–10): 99% priced for +25bp to 2.50%, expected second and final hike.
FOMC (Sep 16) hike odds ~66% on CME FedWatch. PPI Sep 10, CPI Sep 11 in focus.
